comment: Independent bones.c witness for timeout.c save_timers() and restore_timers() on a bones level, with restore.c relink_timers(). A debug human Valkyrie goes to a new level 3, wishes for a troll corpse, whose start_corpse_timeout() schedules a REVIVE_MON timer, drops it, steps east, shoots herself with a wished wand of death, and saves bones. A second game on another seed and clock goes to level 3 and loads the bones; restore_timers() moves the timer to this hero's clock and relink_timers() points it at the restored corpse. The hero then searches until the timer fires and the troll revives out of sight (do.c revive_mon() -> makemon()). The seeds, clocks and inputs were chosen for this path.
